data.hook: Myles Garrett stepped onto the field in Melbourne for his first game with the Rams, but a nagging knee issue held him back from the start.
data.name: Myles Garrett Struggles in Rams Debut Against 49ers
data.summary: The star edge rusher recorded zero tackles, sacks, or QB hits as the Rams lost 27-7 to the San Francisco 49ers in Australia. Fresh off a trade from the Browns and battling knee swelling from training camp, Garrett called it the worst version of himself and focused on recovery over forcing plays. Trent Williams shut him down completely, though some noted Garrett's hurries in advanced stats and the tough matchup while not at full strength.

data.hook: Two NFL teams flew 15 hours to Melbourne, but victory hinged on who cracked the jet lag code best. The 49ers settled in early; the Rams dashed in last-minute with a science-backed plan.
data.name: 49ers Dominate Rams in NFL's Australia Debut Amid Jet Lag Battle
data.summary: The San Francisco 49ers beat the Los Angeles Rams 27-7 in the NFL's first regular-season game at Melbourne Cricket Ground, drawing over 100,000 fans. The 49ers arrived a week early to adjust to the 17-hour time difference, while the Rams used a quick 'in-and-out' trip, staying on Pacific Time with a plane full of lay-flat beds and two years of staff testing. Brock Purdy threw three touchdown passes in the win, sparking talk on which travel method worked better, though one game leaves questions open for the NFL's global push.

data.name: Deshaun Watson Returns for Browns-Jaguars 2026 Opener
data.summary: The Cleveland Browns kick off the 2026 season at 1 p.m. ET in Jacksonville's EverBank Stadium against the 8.5-point favorite Jaguars, marking Watson's first regular-season game since his long layoff amid high scrutiny. This matchup follows a 2025 draft-day trade swapping talents like Travis Hunter to Jacksonville for Cleveland's Mason Graham and others, reshaping both rosters. With new Browns coach Todd Monken revamping the offense, a stout defense, and optimism from Watson calling it a blessing, fans and analysts watch closely as two strong defenses clash and early trajectories take shape.

data.summary: The Arizona Cardinals list third overall pick Jeremiyah Love as questionable for Sunday's game at SoFi Stadium against the Los Angeles Chargers due to his preseason high ankle sprain. Even if active, the team plans to manage his snaps carefully alongside veteran Tyler Allgeier, while guard Isaiah Adams, safety Dadrion Taylor-Demerson, and cornerback Garrett Williams are ruled out.

data.name: Chiefs Rule Out Simmons and Conner for Broncos Clash
data.summary: Kansas City officially ruled left tackle Josh Simmons out with a back injury and safety Chamarri Conner sidelined by a preseason knee issue, both missing all practice this week. Undrafted rookie Benson steps in for his NFL debut at left tackle, facing the Broncos' league-leading pass rush from last season. Chris Jones' calf tightened Friday but coach Andy Reid expects him to play after precautionary measures, while others like Rashee Rice should suit up for the 7:15 p.m. ET kickoff.
